title: Contact groups
subtitle: The groups your business sorts its contacts into. Nexotec maintains the list; you switch on the groups you use.
offNotice: A group switched off stays on the contacts that already carry it. It is no longer offered and cannot be removed from them here.
readOnly: Only the management can switch contact groups on and off.
loadError: The contact groups could not be loaded.
saveError: The change could not be saved.
